## Où j'en suis
The SRE take-home was built and scoped to 3 hours with no Kubernetes: docker compose (flaky-svc built from source, Prometheus, Alertmanager, loadgen), a planted renamed-metric alert bug, a connection leak, an over-broad IAM policy, a README and a 4-area rubric. It was moved out of the infra repo into its own private repo `kestrel-analytics/sre-take-home`, carrying only the exercise commits. Nothing has been sent to the candidate; the session ended with the exercise ready and waiting on Thursday's call.

- [en-cours] `hiring/` removed from the infra branch working tree, not committed since the branch will be dropped
- [prochaine-étape] send the exercise after Thursday's call, invite the candidate as collaborator, drop the infra branch
- [essai-raté] multi-arch `buildx --load` (docker can't load manifest lists) and the amd64-only prebuilt image (exec format error on Apple Silicon)
- [décision] no Kubernetes, 3h max, Terraform + compose only (source: t03)
- [décision] scores feed the panel, no cut-off, Noa second reviewer (source: t10)
- [décision] no email to anyone, Maya sends it herself after the call (source: t16)
